problem.observed: On dev the same _read_bounded_response was duplicated across services/source_ingestion/connectors/taiwan_official.py, alpha_db.py, and social.py. In alpha_db.py and social.py, the reader stopped at the first chunk shorter than chunk_size (if len(chunk) < chunk_size: break), prematurely truncating multi-chunk streams and short reads before end of stream. While SOURCE-TW-OFFICIAL-TRUNCATED-RESPONSE-20261008 fixed the Taiwan official copy to read until EOF (empty chunk), alpha_db and social kept their own flawed duplicates.
problem.cause: Historical code treated len(chunk) < chunk_size as end of stream instead of reading until an empty chunk (b''). Each connector implemented its own copy rather than sharing a single helper.

change: Created services/source_ingestion/connectors/bounded_reader.py providing the single end-of-stream bounded reader helper (read_bounded_response, ResponseTruncated, declared_content_length) that loops until response.read() returns empty bytes (b'') and checks declared Content-Length.
Updated services/source_ingestion/connectors/taiwan_official.py to import bounded reader and remove duplicate definitions.
Updated services/source_ingestion/connectors/alpha_db.py to import bounded reader and remove duplicate short-read breaking definition.
Updated services/source_ingestion/connectors/social.py to import bounded reader and remove duplicate short-read breaking definition.

Updated test doubles in services/source_ingestion/tests/test_provider_management_coverage.py for StockTwits (line 684) and Alpha DB (line 741) to return payload then b'' via mock_resp.read.side_effect.

Added services/source_ingestion/tests/test_bounded_reader.py with 17 unit and connector call path tests covering short chunks before EOF, Content-Length truncation, max byte enforcement, and no-retry behavior.
unchanged: Each connector keeps its current max byte limit (taiwan_official: 10485760, alpha_db: 4194304, social: 2097152) and its error type (SourceEvidenceError) for oversized payloads. No retry policy is added to alpha_db or social. No assertions in test_provider_management_coverage.py are loosened or weakened.
test_changes: Updated mock test doubles in test_provider_management_coverage.py for StockTwits and Alpha DB to return empty chunk after payload to properly model EOF; all test assertions remain strictly unchanged.
